tables.name: a2a_session

tables.comment: Per-agent performance scorecard. Attributes each session to the agents on both sides (initiating and responding), then aggregates outcome metrics per agent: how many sessions it took part in, how many completed, its success rate, and average time to completion. Joins the current a2a_agent version for role/operator/trust context. Note: this measures start -> completed (the terminal lifecycle timestamp on the session), NOT start -> acceptance event; agreement (the acceptance event) can precede completion, so this is the wider end-to-end duration, named accordingly.
tables.name: gold_a2a_agent_scorecard

tables.comment: The A2A negotiation funnel, aggregated by day x channel x product. Each session is counted once at each stage it reached, so downstream can chart initiated -> negotiated -> agreed -> completed conversion and the loss (abandoned / failed / expired) by cut. Grain: one row per (session_date, communication_channel, product_id). NOTE: product_id is nullable on a2a_session (a session need not name a primary product), so all product-less sessions for a given day x channel collapse into one row with a NULL product_id — read that NULL bucket as "no primary product", not missing data.
tables.name: gold_a2a_negotiation_funnel

tables.comment: One row per A2A session with its negotiation outcome rolled up from the append-only event log: how many steps, the first offer, the final agreed price/quantity (from the acceptance event), whether a human was escalated to, and the buyer/seller/agent context. This is the serving surface for "what happened in this negotiation and how did it land".

Definitions: baseline_*        : from the trailing-8 non-promoted-week mean (gold_weekly_baseline), summed over the promo window (i.e. scaled to the promo's duration). incremental_units = promoted_units - baseline_units (NOT clamped; a negative value is a real "promo lost volume" signal). incremental_margin= promoted_margin - baseline_margin, where margin = revenue - units * product.unit_cost. trade_spend       : planned_trade_spend allocated to the category by its share of the promo's scope rows (realized actuals are not modelled — see summary). roi               = incremental_margin / NULLIF(trade_spend, 0). cannibalization   : shortfall below baseline on SUBSTITUTE SKUs (same category, NOT on this promo) in the promo's stores during the window. forward_buy       : shortfall below baseline on the PROMOTED SKUs in the N fiscal weeks after the promo (pantry loading); N = forward_buy_weeks (default 2, see params CTE; keep in sync with seeds.yaml post_promo.forward_buy_weeks). net_incremental_margin = incremental_margin - cannibalization_margin - forward_buy_margin.

tables.comment: ACHIEVED service level vs TARGET, per store x category x fiscal week. Review finding A2 noted the package modeled only service-level TARGETS and never measured attainment, despite inventory_position.is_stockout / stockout_pct_day being available in core. This computes two attained measures with distinct, correctly-labelled definitions (they are NOT interchangeable): - attained_in_stock_rate = 1 - (stockout SKU-days / total SKU-days) A TIME-based measure: the share of SKU-days fully in stock. Answers "how often were we in stock", not "how much demand did we meet". - attained_fill_rate     = units_sold / (units_sold + lost_units) A true DEMAND-weighted (Type II / beta) fill rate: units met divided by units demanded, where unmet demand is the censoring-aware lost_units from lost_sales_estimate (NOT the stockout-constrained actual). tables.comment: The profile-grain, CHANNEL/PURPOSE/JURISDICTION-agnostic do-not-target set: every profile carrying a PERSON-level suppression on ANY current consent scope. Person-level reasons (deceased, fraud, do_not_contact, legal_objection; a GDPR Art.21 direct-marketing objection) are absolute at the person level, so this view is the SINGLE do-not-target consult for EVERY activation plane: * the OWNED-channel gate (gold_customer_activation_eligibility_current) sources it, and * any NON-OWNED / PAID activation (retail-media / DSP / clean-room onboarding built over ACU segment_membership) that does not resolve people through the owned gate MUST anti-join it before targeting, so a person-suppressed customer cannot be uploaded to a paid destination (the cross-plane closure of ADR 0027's "blocks every channel" claim; see ADR 0028). Keyed on the durable profile_id only (no jurisdiction predicate) — matching ADR 0027's deliberate, fail-safe cross-jurisdiction propagation (over-suppress rather than risk under-suppressing a do-not-contact signal that carries legal weight). No PII is exposed (pseudonymous profile_id only).
